verse_brooding.description: Atmospheric, unresolved movement relying on common tones.

pre_chorus_buildup.description: Increasing tension leading into the triumphant chorus. Features the minor iv.

chorus_anthem.description: The soaring, nostalgic payoff with a descending bassline.

primary_scales.name: Aeolian
primary_scales.usage: Base canvas for riffs and arpeggios.

primary_scales.name: Phrygian Dominant
primary_scales.usage: Exotic, aggressive leads; provides the bII crunch.

primary_scales.name: Harmonic Minor
primary_scales.usage: Gothic horror tension; V major to i minor cadences.

progressions.name: The Carpenter bII Crunch
progressions.description: Signature darksynth progression. The bII (Phrygian) crashing down into the tonic creates immense, heavy tension.

progressions.name: Cyber_Drive_Ascent
progressions.description: A driving, relentless progression often used with 16th note basslines for high-speed chase sequences.

progressions.name: Goblin's Descent
progressions.description: Harmonic minor descent emphasizing the leading tone and the semitone clash between V and bVI.

progressions.name: Tritone Hell
progressions.description: Heavy use of the tritone (bV) for dissonant, jarring rhythmic stabs.

bassline_formulas.description: Relentless pedal point with a quick Phrygian passing tone for disruption.

counterpoint_rules.name: Contrary Motion Engine
counterpoint_rules.trigger_condition: Lead moves > a perfect 4th in one direction
counterpoint_rules.action: Move counter-voice in opposite direction by step

counterpoint_rules.name: Sustained Anchor
counterpoint_rules.action: Hold whole notes on chord tones (Root or 5th)

counterpoint_rules.name: Rhythmic Hocket
counterpoint_rules.action: Play on the exact off-beats of the lead

resonance_q.description: Slight resonance boost at cutoff to accentuate the sweep.
